findings.title: New CI demo-no-network grep lint FAILS on the shipped tree - the '^import api/' ban catches demo_api.gleam's own api_error import
findings.detail: Reproduced by running the exact test.yml block on the reviewed tree: VIOLATIONS=[client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:18:import api/api_error.{type ApiError}] -> exit 1. The one W6 piece that landed is broken on arrival: merging makes the lint step permanently red the moment runners unblock, and the reported 'all four lints green' is false. api_error is the shared error type the demo_api mirror needs; either the grep is over-broad or the import must move.
findings.recommended_fix: Move ApiError (or a demo-local alias) off the api/ path the grep bans, or narrow the grep to network-capable api modules; re-run the exact workflow block locally before claiming green.

findings.title: still present since round 2 (fix did not bite): lint_demo_network.py byte-unchanged - cross-arm window bleed reproduced, DEMO_INTERCEPTED never checked against demo_update.handle, zero bite-tests in the repo
findings.location: scripts/lint_demo_network.py:155-163 (35-line flat window), 43-47 (comment-only manifest sync); git show 1c2a6a9..HEAD -- scripts/lint_demo_network.py = empty
findings.detail: The r3 commit message claims 'depth-aware arm boundaries (a cross-arm guard does NOT satisfy) + DEMO_INTERCEPTED verified against demo_update.handle + never-produced trigger check; three bite-tests pass'. None of it exists. Synthetic probe (both Perkins and lens-reproduced): an unguarded vacancy_api call in an arm whose PREVIOUS arm holds a model.demo_mode guard within 35 lines exits 0.
